title: One gateway checks who pays, retries, falls back and prices every model attempt
aria: Two features, the rater and the tutor, send every model call into one gateway. The gateway checks who pays, lists the models to try, calls one model with retries inside a time budget, and on failure falls back to the next model with a fresh budget. In the example the rater's Flash Lite call fails with 503 and Flash answers, and the spend log shows the call cost about four times as much. When no model is left, the feature degrades.

build.title: Two features call a model
build.text: The rater uses `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` with a 2 s budget. The tutor uses `gemini-2.5-flash` with a 4 s budget.

build.title: Every call enters one gateway
build.text: The gateway first asks who pays: a user and a feature, or a reason. A call with none is refused before any request leaves. Then it lists the models to try.

build.title: Call one model, retry inside the budget
build.text: The gateway holds the API key. It retries 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504, waiting 3 s, then 6 s. A wait past the budget means give up. 400, 401 and 403 are never retried.

build.title: Fall back to the next model
build.text: A failed model hands the call to the next one, with a fresh budget, other answers and another price. The worst-case wait is the budget times the number of models. With no model left, the feature degrades.

build.title: Price every attempt
build.text: Every attempt goes to the spend log, failures as zero-token rows. Here the fallback made the call about 4× dearer.

route.title: Check who pays, before any network call
route.text: The rater's call names user 42 (example) and the feature `onboarding_level_chat`. A call without a payer is refused on the spot.

route.title: Build the list of models to try
route.text: The named model goes first, then every other enabled model by priority: [Flash Lite, Flash].

route.title: Retry only what a retry can fix, inside the budget
route.text: Flash Lite answers 503. A second try would come after 3 s, which does not fit the 2 s budget, so the gateway gives up on Flash Lite.

route.title: Write down the failure too
route.text: The failed attempt reports no tokens. It is still recorded, as a zero-token row marked as an error.

route.title: Fall back to the next model
route.text: Flash gets a fresh 2 s budget and answers at 1.1 s. The feature never sees the outage, but its answer now comes from a different model.

route.title: Price the attempt the moment it happens
route.text: The rows are priced at today's rates and written in the background while the answer goes back. One `GROUP BY` over feature, user or model then shows the ×4.
